info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Delinquent Account Handling-v5-spec
info.description: The Delinquent Account Handling API enables banks and financial institutions to manage delinquent accounts effectively. With this API, authorized users can initiate processes to address accounts that are overdue, enhancing operational efficiency. Typical consumers include banking operations teams and financial analysts focused on debt recovery. Key functionalities include account status updates, notifications, and intervention measures, ensuring timely engagement with delinquent account holders.

post.description: This operation allows you to manage accounts that are considered delinquent, providing a means to implement handling processes such as payment plans or collections. It aims to help restore account statuses and improve overall financial health.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the necessary information to handle a delinquent account operation. This includes details about the account, the nature of the delinquency, and any specific instructions for processing the request.
